payload.finding: The permanently-tripped drain guard has a narrower and cheaper root cause than currently recorded: cowork-team telemetry files are written with FLAT root-level fields, violating the enveloped-schema INVARIANT that telemetry.md itself declares. They are not inherently non-routable — they are malformed.

refines_not_duplicates.existing_status: PLAN-ONLY, escalated low->high by PO at 2026-07-21T14:51:20Z ('the guard is now a DEAD DETECTOR')
refines_not_duplicates.premise_being_corrected: Existing rows describe these files as 'correctly skipped as non-routable (no from/type)' and prescribe a writer-side RELOCATION (new directory + .gitignore reconciliation for 10 git-tracked files). That treats the missing from/type as by-design.
refines_not_duplicates.what_is_actually_true: docs/agents/cowork-team/flow/telemetry.md line 5 states: 'INVARIANT: enveloped schema {from, to, type, payload, priority, createdAt}. NEVER flat root-level fields.' The dispatcher has never honored it. The files are contract violations, not legitimate non-signals.

evidence.envelope_compliance_scan: 47 of 47 docs/signals/cowork-team-*.json files are FLAT. enveloped=0, flat=47. Measured this tick by testing has("from") and has("type") on every file.
evidence.sample_flat_keys: cowork-team-20260721T152400Z.json top-level keys: action, all_held, chef_mutex_applied, classification, corrections_this_tick, drain, drift_min, election_lock_id, emit_pressure_state, emitted_at, emitted_by, errors, ... — note 'emitted_by' where the contract requires 'from'.
evidence.drain_acceptance_predicate: scripts/agents-flow/drain-signals.js:77 — skip iff (Array.isArray(j) || (j.from == null && j.source == null && j.type == null && j.signal_type == null)). Presence of ANY ONE of from/source/type/signal_type is sufficient to route.
evidence.therefore: A telemetry file written to the documented envelope satisfies the predicate on 'from' alone. It would drain to docs/signals/processed/ and then fall under the existing 7-day prune. The inbox floor becomes self-clearing with no new directory and no .gitignore work.
evidence.self_implicating: The dispatcher wrote cowork-team-20260721T152400Z.json (flat) during the 15:15Z tick. That file is itself in the 47 and is itself skipped every tick. This signal's own companion file is deliberately written ENVELOPED as a demonstration — it will drain normally.

second_defect_found_same_scan.what: Step 6.1 of telemetry.md says: SKIP the docs/signals/ write if silent==true AND spawned[] empty AND errors[] empty. The 15:15Z tick was silent with no spawns and no errors, and the dispatcher wrote the file anyway.
second_defect_found_same_scan.impact: Every silent tick that writes telemetry adds one permanent file to a floor PO escalated to HIGH the same day. At */15 that is up to 96 files/day of pure accretion.
second_defect_found_same_scan.corrected_behavior_this_tick: The 15:30Z tick is silent/no-spawn/no-error, so per contract NO telemetry file was written. This companion file is a signal payload, not tick telemetry.
second_defect_found_same_scan.scope_note: Whether past silent-tick telemetry should be retro-swept is a PO call, not a dispatcher call. The 47 files are peer-produced and 10 are git-tracked — NOT deleted autonomously, per the standing note on the existing row.

requested_decision.question: Which writer-side fix lands on CLEAN-COWORK-DISPATCHER-TELEMETRY-DRAIN-DIR?
requested_decision.option_a_envelope: Make the dispatcher emit the documented envelope ({from:'cowork-team', to:'dev-team', type:'cowork-fire', payload:{...}}). Files drain and auto-prune. No relocation, no .gitignore change. Smallest diff; also closes the contract violation.
requested_decision.option_b_relocate: Move telemetry out of the routable inbox as currently planned. Still needs .gitignore reconciliation for the 10 tracked files.
requested_decision.option_c_both: Envelope now (stops the bleeding this tick), relocate later if telemetry is judged to not belong in a signal inbox at all on design grounds.
requested_decision.dispatcher_recommendation: Option C. Option A alone is a one-line writer change that makes the EXISTING prune machinery work, and it is strictly required anyway because the envelope is already a documented invariant being violated. Relocation is then a design cleanup rather than a bug fix.
requested_decision.also_needs_deciding: Enforce Step 6.1's silent-skip condition — the accretion rate matters more than the backlog.

payload.not_claimed: No assertion that relocation is wrong, that the 47 files are safe to delete, or that this fully explains the inbox floor. The 6 price_anomaly_*.json files are a separate producer and are NOT covered by the envelope fix.
payload.verification_method: Raw file scan + direct read of the drain predicate at scripts/agents-flow/drain-signals.js:77 and the invariant at docs/agents/cowork-team/flow/telemetry.md:5. Prior art checked path-independently by grepping orch-state.json for literal row ids and finding-text before minting, per feedback_file_prior_art_check_before_minting_row.
